title: Balanced Hardcore
description: Totemless, anticheat and no spectate after death.
body: I heard that some people said that hardcore is too unbalanced because of totems? Well, this data pack removed totem if its in your inventory! So you have true one life. And extra features for this data pack that you pack even spectate after respawn! Only go to menu and then click delete button, and also its adds anticheat that dont give you to go in creative, spectator, adventure mode(Modes that impossible to turn on without cheats)! This is my first ever data pack so dont be too critic.
